source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: As the Declare Battle Formations step begins, this model may be added to one of your GUARDIAN DEFENDERS units, provided no other SUPPORT WEAPON model has joined that unit. From then until the battle ends, it is treated as belonging to that GUARDIANS unit, whose Starting Strength goes up to include it. Neither this model nor any unit it has joined can ever embark within a TRANSPORT.

detail.when: start of the Declare Battle Formations step

join.recipient: one GUARDIAN DEFENDERS unit from your army

cannotEmbark: any unit it is joined to
